name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment. That's why reset links point at localhost for these users. A pull request has been opened to ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/validated in production so BASE_URL resolves to the real public URL.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used to build the password reset link (and other links) sent in emails. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, users receive links pointing at localhost instead of the real site.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production deployment configuration, and/or make the code fail fast (throw or log an error at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, rather than silently falling back to localhost. This prevents broken reset/report links from being emailed to users when the environment variable is absent or misconfigured after a release.
